items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Frankie Duesen was a power-offer. And Connie was a power-offer. All them fellas, you know.

ctx.x: Fast, huh? Just like a trumpet.

Yeah, that's what I'm talking about. Yeah, and him and little George Washington. Oh, Jack wasn't needing that jackal and power-off, you know. Frankie Duesen was a power-offer. And Connie was a power-offer. All them fellas, you know. But I'm talking about like, little George Washington, you play something, he'd be playing this little more just like he'd be playing on the trumpet. Yeah, I mean Earl. But Jack said there was no trombone playing, Jack see. Jack see, there ain't no trombone playing, they ain't got no…
I don't know what happened to him either.
